```yaml
name: Append Roadmap Sections

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  append-roadmap:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: true
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Git user
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Append new roadmap sections
        run: |
          cat <<'EOF' >> docs/roadmap.md
          ## Document Understanding Tasks
          - Table structure recognition
          - Key-value extraction
          - Reading order
          - Handwriting recognition
          - Scene text detection
          - Document classification
          - Multi-page context handling
          - Figure/Chart awareness

          ## Data Augmentation (SynthDoG)
          - Realistic noise injection
          - Complex layout generation

          ## Modeling Additions
          - Quantization recipes
          - Confidence estimation
          - Serving example
          - ONNX/TRT export
          - Data mixing strategy
          - Experiment tracking

          ## Benchmarking Additions
          - Robustness benchmarks
          - Commercial API comparison
          - Cross-dataset generalization
          - CI regression testing
          - Failure mode taxonomy
          - Domain-specific benchmarks

          ## Developer Experience
          - Unified CLI
          - Tutorials
          - Model cards
          - Output format interoperability

          ## Suggested Priority Order (Impact)
          1. Robustness benchmarks
          2. Quantization recipes
          3. Confidence estimation
          4. ONNX/TRT export
          5. CI regression testing
          6. Unified CLI
          7. Model cards
          8. Data augmentation
          9. Document understanding tasks
          10. Benchmarking cross-dataset generalization
          EOF

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet docs/roadmap.md; then
            echo "No changes to commit."
          else
            git add docs/roadmap.md
            git commit -m "Add new roadmap sections"
            git push
          fi
```
